item.title: Zoominoes
item.description:
Title: Zoominoes
Genre: Indie , Strategy
Developer: Starlight Games inc.
Publisher: Starlight Games inc.
Release Date: Jul 30, 2026




About This Game

Zoominoes is the ultimate tile deck builder all about combining cards on a board to score infinite points.

Crazy Combos

Upgrade animals using snacks and souvenirs to create crazy combos. Transform your simple starting deck into the perfect masterpiece. Manipulate the board with space modifiers to boost your score even more. Focus on different animal types or color build arounds to create the ultimate scoring army.

Become The Ultimate Zookeeper

Play as a variety of 20 different Zookeepers. Be anyone from a Rich Evil Zoo Ceo, a Diva Herpetologist, a shop-a-holic, to an extreme adventure Survivalist.

Collect Everything

  • 219 Animals each with a fun fact to unlock.

  • 35 Snacks can help you customize your deck exactly how you want.

  • 112 Souvenirs to double, multiply, and transform how everything plays.

  • 20 Zookeepers all featuring their own unique starting decks, abilities, and personalities.

  • 26 Special Events that place unique modifiers to shake up the average day.

  • 8 Difficulty levels to work your way up the Zoo ladder from Volunteer to Director.

Features

  • Endless Mode: Keep your run going after beating the full 28 Day month and try to reach Day 56 and score infinite points!

  • Daily Run: Compete against the world everyday with a new seeded run. Will you become king of the jungle?

  • Challenges Mode: 24 extra challenges await with Chally. Attempt to earn all 192 points and complete his varying wild missions!

item.title: MineGeon: Renegades
item.description:
Title: MineGeon: Renegades
Genre: Action , Adventure , Indie , RPG
Developer: Kickstone Studio
Publisher: Kickstone Studio
Release Date: Jul 30, 2026




About This Game

After a failed heist, a group known as the Renegades is forced to flee, crash landing near the mysterious planet Paimo. With no other choice, they descend into its depths in search of help and uncover secrets that should have remained buried.

DESCEND WITH FRIENDS

Descend solo or with up to two friends into the dangerous depths of PAIMO. Coordinate your abilities, share gadgets, and work together to survive. But watch your back... sometimes you’ll need to unleash your inner Renegade and break away from the group to maximize your rewards.

GADGETS, WEAPONS AND ULTIMATES

Inside the MineGeon, every run is a chance to grow stronger. Level up to unlock powerful Gadgets that grant a wide variety of upgrades to aid you in battle, equip a variety of weapons to match your playstyle, and choose Ultimates that can completely change how you approach combat. Combining Gadgets, Weapons, and Ultimates creates unique synergies that will shape your descent into PAIMO.

BRING OUT YOUR INNER GREED

PAIMO is filled with minerals that bring out your inner greed. The deeper you descend, the greater the rewards and the risks. Collect valuable minerals and trade them for permanent upgrades, but choose wisely when to send them back to your ship.

FACE ENEMIES DESPERATE TO STOP YOU

The biomes of PAIMO are home to a vast array of enemies. Throughout your journey, you’ll encounter the Scavengers, who will do anything to stop your descent. Why are they so determined to keep you from going deeper? Each biome culminates in a boss battle that will push your skills and strategies to the limit.

GROW STRONGER EVERY RUN

Progression is key to your survival and success. As you explore and gather resources, you can upgrade your skills and equipment to grow stronger with every run. Invest in permanent upgrades for your spaceship and enhance each Renegade’s attributes to prepare for the challenges ahead.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR SHIP

Access the Galactic Express PC to buy over 200 items, decorations, and themed objects from the biomes you explore, and customize the interior of your ship to your liking. Organize your base, visit other Renegades' ships online, and show off your setup to the community.

CHOOSE YOUR RENEGADE

Choose from three classes, each with their own ultimate ability and unique stats. From Marshall, the resilient Tank, to Trevor, the deadly DPS Gunslinger, and Ari, the balanced Engineer. Find your role within the team and combine your strengths with other Renegades to maximize your chances of surviving the descent into PAIMO.

CHOOSE YOUR DESCENT

Deep within PAIMO lie mysterious monoliths pulsing with ancient technology. These relics let the Renegades decide how to continue their descent, vote as a team to choose the path that benefits everyone, or follow your own ambition.

Add MineGeon: Renegades to your wishlist and join the adventure!

item.title: Leafy Corner
item.description:
Title: Leafy Corner
Genre: Casual , Indie , Simulation
Developer: Fireline Games
Publisher: Fireline Games
Release Date: Jul 30, 2026




About This Game

Run the plant shop of your dreams in Leafy Corner, a cozy shop management game where you grow, sell, and care for real-life houseplants!

Step into the role of a plant shop owner. Grow plants, serve your customers, and create a warm, inviting space filled with greenery and charm.

Watch your plants grow over time, unfolding leaf by leaf as you care for them.

Not everyone knows what they’re looking for. Sometimes customers bring unusual or tricky requests. Finding just the right plant to fit their needs adds a fun challenge.

Decorate your shop with a variety of unlockable items, from shelves to plant pots. Pick colors that fit your mood and create a space that reflects your unique style.

KEY FEATURES

  • Grow, care for, and sell 100+ unique plants.

  • Discover plant variegations.

  • Build and decorate your shop with a variety of pots, furniture, and decoration options.

  • Fulfill orders and help customers.

  • Complete tasks to progress your shop.

  • Increase your shop’s reputation to unlock new content.

  • Customize your character.

What Leafy Corner does NOT offer:

  • Hardcore management (deep economy, hiring staff).

  • Advanced plant care.

  • Storyline.

We are working hard and pouring our hearts into making Leafy Corner. You can support us by wishlisting and following the game on Steam. And if you want to chat with us or fellow plant lovers, you can find us on Discord!

item.title: Kusan: City of Wolves
item.description:
Title: Kusan: City of Wolves
Genre: Action , Indie
Developer: CIRCLEfromDOT
Publisher: PQube
Franchise: PQube
Release Date: Jul 30, 2026




About This Game

Brutal, precise gunplay where every move counts. Stylish play is rewarded as you dominate tightly designed arenas.

Fight through 54 intense stages across multiple chapters with skill-based puzzles, challenges and S-ranks for perfectionists—for lone wolves and high score chasers.

Face towering foes with distinctive mechanics and high-stakes patterns. Learn, adapt and execute to survive cinematic duels that push timing and tactics to the limit.

Optimise and improvise - Chain kills, parries and get into the flow to earn Bolts and upgrade the War Hand, unlock firearms and blades and tailor loadouts to your playstyle.

Follow Jin’s missions through dynamic comic-panel cutscenes—sharp frames, cinematic pacing and a gritty tale of violence, corruption and fractured loyalties.

A rain-soaked pixel-art metropolis where Jin is ready to cross every line to save the girl.

Welcome to Kusan: City of Wolves , a brutal top-down shooter set in a neon-drenched urban jungle consumed by violence and corruption.

Kusan delivers hardcore action where one mistake means death. Master gunplay, perfect your movement, survive the streets and combat arenas ruled by furious kingpins that demand speed, precision and flawless execution. Every moment of action is intensified by Korean hip-hop heavyweight Loptimist’s adrenaline-fuelled soundtrack drenched with head-bopping loops and deep 808s pushing you forward without mercy.

You play as Jin, a skilled ex-soldier turned gun-for-hire, living in the heart of a city where the line between predator and prey has already been crossed. This isn’t just another job though, a mysterious girl with immense but uncontrollable power is linked to a violent conspiracy that threatens to shift the balance of power. As chaos erupts, Jin must save the girl, confront his past and the betrayal of a commander he once trusted without question.

Everyone in Kusan wants something and nobody plays fair.

For Jin, there is only one way forward: flawless planning, ruthless execution and saving the girl from criminals while relying only on his wit and unrelenting will to survive the battlefield.

With the whole city at stake, Jin knows it is time to not only clean-house but restore balance.

Features:

Hardcore top-down combat with style

Brutal, precise gunplay where every move counts. Stylish play is rewarded as you dominate tightly designed arenas.

54 Hand-crafted Stages & Mastery

Fight through 54 intense stages across multiple chapters with skill-based puzzles, challenges and S-ranks for perfectionists—for lone wolves and high score chasers.

Beastly Boss Battles

Face towering foes with distinctive mechanics and high-stakes patterns. Learn, adapt and execute to survive cinematic duels that push timing and tactics to the limit.

War Hand & Arsenal

Optimise and improvise - Chain kills, parries and get into the flow to earn Bolts and upgrade the War Hand, unlock firearms and blades and tailor loadouts to your playstyle.

Adrenaline-fuelled Soundtrack

An adrenaline-fuelled score from Korean hip-hop artist Loptimist serving heavy doses of energy.

Graphic-Novel Storytelling

Follow Jin’s missions through dynamic comic-panel cutscenes—sharp frames, cinematic pacing and a gritty tale of violence, corruption and fractured loyalties.

Neo-Noir Atmosphere

A rain-soaked pixel-art metropolis where Jin is ready to cross every line to save the girl.

Dive into Kusan: City of Wolves and descend into a city on the edge. It's more than just a fight, you are the last line between order and oblivion.

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

This game includes content that is not suitable for all ages or that may be inappropriate for use at work.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 (64bit)
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: GeForce GTX 660, 2 GB or AMD Radeon R9 270X, 2 GB
    • Storage: 3 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: 1080p @ 60 FPS
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 11 (64bit)
    • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970, 4 GB or AMD Radeon RX 590, 8 GB
    • Storage: 3 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: 2160p @ 60 FPS

item.title: Machine Party
item.description:
Title: Machine Party
Genre: Action , Indie
Developer: Mike Klubnika , GDeavid
Publisher: Oro Interactive
Release Date: Jul 30, 2026




About This Game

Welcome to Machine Party. In this series of dangerous, and some would say highly illegal, party games you will have to use every trick in the book to survive. Play through classic party game formats and new twists on the genre for sessions of fun, screaming, and horror.

Features

  • A collection of uniquely violent party games

  • Support for 2 - 4 players

  • An industrial soundtrack by Alex Peipman

  • Customize your test subject

  • Multiple devious ways of screwing your friends over

Mature Content Description

Frequent gory outcomes from losing mini games



System Requirements
